To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the contribution from Roper resonance becomes significant for kinetic energies of incident proton above 1. 1 GeV, the t-channel sigma-mesons exchange is dominant for Roper production, and the contribution from the t-channel sigma exchange is important for the pp -> p pi(+) reaction.
the Roper resonance is a significant contributor to the pp -> pnpi+ reaction for T-pi above 1.0 GeV.

the Roper resonance plays a significant role in the pp -> p n pi(+) reaction at kinetic energies above 1.2 GeV and the dominant production mechanism of the Roper in the pp -> n pi(+) is via t-channel sigma-mesons.

the role of the N*(1 4 4 0 ) resonance for the production of pion from the proton in the pp -> p n p i ( ) reaction.
the role of the N*(1 440) resonance in the p p -> p n pi(+) reaction and the new measurement by CELSIUSS-WASA Collaboration on this process.
the role of the N*( 1440) resonance for the pp → pn π + reaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the role of the N*(1 440) in the reaction pp -> pn pi+ is important for the kinetic energy region above 1. 1 GeV.
the Roper resonance plays an important role in the pp -> pi(+) pn reaction at kinetic energies above 1.2 GeV.
the new data on the pp -> pi(+) pn reaction at CELSIUS-WASP are in excellent agreement with the predictions of the present model and that the Roper resonance is clearly seen in this reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the Roper resonance can not be ignored in the description of the pp -> pnpi reaction at higher energies.
we have found that the Roper resonance plays an important role in the pp -> npi(+) reaction.
the N(1440) resonance plays a significant role in the pp -> p(n)pi(+) reaction at the intermediate energy region.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we have found a clear evidence for the N*(144 0) resonance contribution in the pp -> p n pi(+) reaction, and we have shown that the N*(144(0)) contribution is important for the pp -> p(n) pi(+) reaction above the threshold of the Roper production.
the Roper resonance is not negligible in the pp -> pi(+)(n)(p) reaction.
